title: A transfer that can debit without crediting
prompt: TRANSFER.sqlrpgle debits one account and credits another as two independent statements, so a failure between them leaves the money nowhere. Put both under commitment control: commit when both succeeded, roll back and set the error flag otherwise. Check SQLCODE after each statement rather than assuming it worked.
check: codeonly TRANSFER.sqlrpgle | grep -qiE 'exec +sql +commit' && codeonly TRANSFER.sqlrpgle | grep -qiE 'exec +sql +rollback' && [ $(codeonly TRANSFER.sqlrpgle | grep -ciE 'sqlcode') -ge 2 ] && codeonly TRANSFER.sqlrpgle | grep -qiE 'commit *\( *\*(chg|all|cs|rr) *\)'
